title: Sh*t Is Falling From The Sky
text: What public authorities are learning is that something's being sprayed out of jets up in the sky above the states, above towns and cities. And it's under the guise of geoengineering. Geoengineering is supposed to be barerium, reflective metal. When dropped out of the sky, it's supposed to reflect sunlight, cool down the planet, stop global warming. That's the goal anyway. But that's not truth. That's not what's really happening. It's way more sinister. Geoengineering, the release of dangerous chemicals out of planes every single day are for other reasons. For destructive reasons, for despicable evil reasons, has nothing to do with saving the planet. What they're doing and what they're doing up in the sky and the chemicals that they're dropping on everybody is a crime. It's a crime on humanity, an evil, evil one. And it happens like clockwork every single hour, every single day. Nobody knows what it is that they're dropping on people. We're not supposed to know anything. And if anybody questions it, it's a conspiracy theory. You got a tinfoil hat or you're just a paranoid crazy prepper. Let's just put it this way. There are a lot of things flying in the air that are spraying stuff on everybody. Really simplifying it, is falling out of the sky and evil people are doing it.
